messages:
rohan: seeing a weird one — ~2-3% of SSE sessions from eu-west are entering a hard reconnect loop after a resume. clients see: "EventSource error: connection closed" but server logs show no error.

anita: interesting, any pattern on proxies / edge nodes?

rohan: looks concentrated on edge-4 and edge-9, both behind the same nginx config. tcpdump shows FIN from proxy then client reconnects quickly. nothing in runtime logs for the session id.

maya: could be keepalive mismatch — nginx might be closing idle upstream while client still thinks stream is open. do we have x-keepalive header hops?

sam: echoing that. also saw resume_id present in client reconnect but proxy sometimes strips our x-resume header on reproxying. that would make resume attempts no-op.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T05:12 rolled nginx v1.22 -> v1.24 on edges 4/9. no config changes.

rohan: patching proxy to preserve x-resume-id for reproxy path now. also saw this pattern in logs:

```
[edge-4] tcp FIN from upstream 10.0.9.8:443
[edge-4] client reconnect, headers: Host: api.redwood.ai, x-resume-id: null
[app] no session found for resume-id 0x0
```

anita: if proxy strips header then resume becomes new session -> server creates new session but old session cleanup might send final close that gets delivered to new connection? weird race.

maya: can we add console telemetry: resume_attempt, resume_success, resume_mismatch, proxy_drop? want per-tenant counts + per-edge.

dash-team: +1 to telemetry. prefer using existing label set: route, edge, tenant_id, resume_result=success|not_found|proxy_dropped. avoid adding new metric names if we can tag.

sam: small debate: tagging resume_result retains cardinality; if we emit resume_mismatch as a separate metric it triggers existing alerts. what about adding a short-lived counter "stream.resume.replay_attempts" with tag result?

anita: i'm fine with a counter + tags. concrete plan: emit counter on resume entrypoint with tags (edge, tenant, route, resume_present=[true|false]). increment extra counter when proxy header missing.

rohan: i pushed a debug build to edge-9 that logs headers and keeps a 30s tombstone for session ids, to detect rebinds. canary at 1% tonight?

oncall: schedule wise — want to avoid global roll. start canary 1% for 2 hours, if resume_success ratio stays > 99.5% promote. set alert threshold at 98.5% for the canary.

sam: console UX: add a new chart under Streaming -> Reconnects showing resume_attempts/resume_success over time with edge filter. also add per-route delta when toggling dedicated routing policies.

dash-team: we can add a stacked bar: success / not_found / proxy_dropped. i'll mock in prototype and push in an internal feature flag.

maya: quick workaround: set nginx proxy_read_timeout longer and set `proxy_set_header X-Resume-Id $http_x_resume_id;` explicitly. need infra approval?

infra-bot: manual review required for nginx config change on stable. file a PR with impact and canary plan.

rohan: created PR #8423 with config change + header preserve clause + telemetry emit. also included small middleware:

```python
# in sse_proxy middleware
resume_id = req.headers.get('x-resume-id')
if resume_id:
    metrics.counter('stream.resume.attempt', tags={...})
else:
    metrics.counter('stream.resume.missing_header', tags={...})
```

anita: question: do we return 410 if resume_id present but no session? currently we treat as start-of-stream. returning 410 would make client fallback faster but could break some SDK logic.

sam: i'd avoid returning 410 default. prefer server to treat missing session as fresh stream and emit 'resume_not_found' telemetry. then we can add a client-side optimisation later.

oncall: agreed. ops is conservative. prefer observability first.

rohan: timeline: canary tonight with header preserve + longer timeouts + telemetry tags. if we see proxy_dropped > 0.2% on canary, rollback.

maya: also add a one-off log shipper to capture full headers for a sample of failed resumes (redact auth). useful for root cause.

dash-team: will add dashboard tile and a console flag to view raw failed-resume samples (read-only).

rohan: thanks folks. i'll post a short incident update in #incidents if canary shows improvement.

sam: tiny follow-up — add unit test for header pass-through in proxy integration tests, caught us previously.

anita: marked as high-priority for this sprint.

rohan: tracking: PR 8423, canary 1% edge-9/edge-4, dashboard tile draft. will update by 06:00 UTC tomorrow.
